nodes.label: Frontend Stack (React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui)
Backend Stack (Python 3.11 + FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 + Alembic + PostgreSQL)
Storage Stack (MinIO local / AWS S3 prod)
Google Fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans, Fira Code)
auth_service (register, login, invite, accept_invitation, get_current_user, require_role)
ProjectSwitcher Component (nav dropdown, stores active project_id in context + localStorage)
Alembic Migration (multi-tenant tables: org, user, project, member, invitation)
Procurement Workflow (Org → Project → Requirements → RFQs → Quotes → PO → Invoice)
Tenant Isolation Rule (org_id on every DB query, from current_user never request body, 404 not 403)
Role Hierarchy (super-admin, org-admin, buyer, vendor-user, viewer)
Requirement Model (org_id, project_id, status ENUM, delivery_date)
LineItem Model (description, part_number, quantity, unit, specs, category)
requirement_repo (all methods take org_id, enforces tenant isolation)
SubmitPage (text area + file upload, parse button, editable TanStack Table)
Regex Text Parser (parse_text_to_items — NO AI, pure regex for qty/unit/description)
Rationale: org_id Enforcement in Every Repository Method (tenant isolation by design)
